scope:
Run an isolated full-G1 tool pickup attempt in the existing laboratory.

Starts at an explicitly authored posture. An observed-approach station enables
native cameras and a separate visual actor. Neither execution mode grants
task-branch or repeated-reliability qualification by itself.

contact_solver_revision.purpose: Closed-loop contact-model sensitivity trial; friction, geometry, mass, controller and acceptance limits are retained

hand_tool_compliance_revision.scope:
Bind an explicit, uncalibrated fingertip/tool compliance sensitivity trial.

The steel tool's high-priority 0.9999 contact impedance otherwise overrides
the finger contact model. This candidate changes only normal/tangential solver
impedance on the declared gripping interfaces. It preserves the surfaces,
friction, time constant, contact dimension, zero margin/gap and all limits.
Neither impedance value is a measured hardware material property.

inferred_control.approach_velocity_feedforward: Mean commanded wrist translation and world rotation velocity over each 10 ms balance period; approach phase only
inferred_control.hand_feedback_rule: Inertia eigenmodes: kp=min(3,0.25*I/dt^2); kd=min(2*sqrt(kp*I),0.4*scale*I/dt); scale applies only after load entry in loaded phases
inferred_control.startup_com_shift: Two-second smooth movement from initial COM toward support center

release_preserve_posture.inputs: Own commanded non-closing hand joint angles at release entry
release_preserve_posture.basis: Retain the supported grasp preshape while opening distal drivers; restoring proximal angles can push the fingertip into the tool

release_compensation_decay.inputs: Previous own non-closing-joint compensation command at release entry

lower_xy_correction.basis: Authored station-frame correction away from the tray rim; not online plant pose input

lower_clearance_motion.basis: Stop the commanded lowering before finger/tray contact; independent release checks must still establish passive support

carry_contract.scope: Local loaded stepping and return to observed source; no cross-station or paper-branch qualification
carry_contract.collision_guard_scope: Right arm and rigid grasp hypothesis versus public map and observed surfaces; full plant assessed independently
carry_contract.motor_load_observer_bound_basis: Authored controller stop bound, at most half the unchanged source driver effort; not a physical acceptance limit
carry_contract.proximal_preshape_basis: Authored signed index/middle proximal offset while supported; existing distal force feedback, material friction and physical acceptance bounds retained
carry_contract.body_route_scope: Same physical out-and-back distance, two-foot stepping, retention and return requirements; no rotated arm withdrawal stage
carry_contract.prelift_native_load_thresholds: Same independently measured thumb/opposing contact thresholds as physical_acceptance

empty_hand_base_return.target: Original declared initial base XY; proprioceptive robot estimate
empty_hand_base_return.clearance: Observed arm/source meshes plus native source self-contact at the released encoder-derived finger pose
